Container.Name: seed-agent-media-worker
Container.Overview: Independent media worker. Before deployment replace Repository with the same verified immutable image as seed, set its digest below, and align the one shared config directory and media state. No Web or downloader access. Mount source and library under ONE common RW parent; application source preservation is not kernel-enforced RO. See deploy/media-worker.md.

Config.Name: Shared Config Directory
Config.Description: Existing shared config DIRECTORY; atomic replacements must remain visible. No independent config copy.

Config.Name: Independent Media State
Config.Description: Existing explicitly initialized media state shared with seed/Web command control; never point to seed state.

Config.Name: Common Media Parent
Config.Description: ONE parent containing source and library on compatible filesystem. No nested/RO overlays or separate source and target mounts: link(2) may return EXDEV. Source bytes/names/permissions preserved by application.

Config.Name: TMDB Credential
Config.Description: Only this enabled provider credential file. Remove mount if unused.

Config.Name: OpenSubtitles Credential
Config.Description: Only this enabled provider credential file. Remove mount if unused.

Config.Name: ASSRT Credential
Config.Description: Only this enabled provider credential file. Remove mount if unused.

Config.Name: SubDL Credential
Config.Description: Only this enabled provider credential file. Remove mount if unused.

Config.Name: Verified Image Digest
Config.Description: Set the verified digest of Repository. Health displays configured and worker-applied identity; runtime inspect still verifies the actual image.
